primary_title: IRF1 Is a Transcriptional Regulator of ZBP1 Promoting NLRP3 Inflammasome Activation and Cell Death during Influenza Virus Infection
decision_basis: The review identifies Zbp1 as an IRF1-induced transcriptional target during influenza infection; the cited primary shows reduced Zbp1 transcript and protein in Irf1-deficient cells and identifies IRF1 as a transcriptional regulator of ZBP1.
limitations_preserved: IRF1-dependent Zbp1 transcription is supported in influenza-infected mouse macrophage/fibroblast systems; preserve infection and type-I-IFN context, and do not infer ZBP1 protein sufficiency, NLRP3 activation in every state, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

primary_title: A ChIP-chip approach reveals a novel role for transcription factor IRF1 in the DNA damage response
decision_basis: The review identifies BRIP1 as an IRF1-regulated DNA-repair gene; the cited primary demonstrates IFN-gamma/IRF1-associated promoter occupancy and increased BRIP1 mRNA and protein after IRF1 overexpression, with loss after IRF1 knockdown.
limitations_preserved: IRF1 promoter occupancy and perturbation-supported BRIP1 transcription establish a bounded gene-activation edge; preserve IFN-responsive H3396 and DNA-crosslink context, and do not infer BRIP1 protein function or universal DNA-repair phenotypes automatically.

primary_title: Interferon activates promoter of Nmi gene via interferon regulator factor-1
decision_basis: The review's IRF1 target-gene discussion and cited promoter study support interferon-responsive IRF1 gene regulation; the primary maps an NMI promoter ISRE, shows IRF1-dependent promoter activation and reduced IFN-induced NMI transcription after IRF1 knockdown.
limitations_preserved: IRF1-dependent NMI promoter activation is supported at the gene-transcription layer; preserve the IFN-responsive promoter/ISRE and cultured-cell context, and do not infer NMI protein abundance, downstream signaling or SCI effects automatically.
